text.p: Swiss shares failed to recover from midday lows and closed below the psychologically important level of 3,800 points on the blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI).

"It was a boring session", a dealer said, adding that the index may remain stuck in a range between 3,790 and 3,815 points. "The market just does not have enough power to overcome the strong resistance around 3,820," he said.
Volumes were low with foreign investors largely absent.
The SMI ended down 15.1 points, or 0.4 percent, at 3,788.2 and the broad SPI fell 8.87 points, or 0.36 percent, to 2,429.65.
Nine month figures for Ciba, Sandoz and ABB, due on Tuesday, may give the market a boost, one dealer said. Shares of the three companies lost around 0.3 percent each.
Roche, which led the actives list, fell five francs to 9,640. Nestle gave up seven francs to end at 1,404.
Electrowatt closed down 1.22 percent at 484 francs after recent highs on rumours CS Holding might sell its 45 percent stake in the company. Surveillance was up 60 francs to 2,870.
Swissair fell 1.57 percent to 1,001 on worries over higher fuel prices and market uncertainty about how the cooperation of Delta and Air France will affect Swissair, a dealer said.
Insurer Baloise were unchanged at 2,600 francs while most others financials were weaker.
